quote: The Austrian capital [[Vienna]] was to be hit by two 500-kiloton bombs.
notes: SECONDARY (Wikipedia, en revid 1369632420; pl 'W siedem dni do rzeki Ren' revid 77709939). The 1979 plan itself was not opened; the row is NOT attributable to the 1979 plan: cited to Telegraph 1 Dec 2001 'Vienna was top of Soviet nuclear targets list' = PHP 1965 Hungarian war game; primary checked: see wp_1965_hu_wargame. Matches primary (BÉCS 2 x 500 kt). pl article agrees.

source_doc: Wikipedia (en) 'Seven Days to the River Rhine', section 'Known targets' (wikitext via API), cross-checked with pl 'W siedem dni do rzeki Ren'
quote: [[Stuttgart]], [[Munich]], and [[Nuremberg]] in [[West Germany]] were to be destroyed by nuclear weapons, and then captured by the Czechoslovaks and Hungarians.
notes: SECONDARY (Wikipedia, en revid 1369632420; pl 'W siedem dni do rzeki Ren' revid 77709939). The 1979 plan itself was not opened; the row is NOT attributable to the 1979 plan: cited to Telegraph 20 Sep 2007 'Soviet plan for WW3 nuclear attack unearthed' (1964 Czechoslovak plan). The 1964 plan text (PHP translation) names Nuremberg/Stuttgart/Munich only as axes of advance, not as nuclear targets. pl agrees.
